card.name: Core and Impact at word starts
card.fires_on: The word "core" or "Core", the word "Impact" after "Clinical", or the start of a split word like "Achie" or "VF", where the next piece is expected to continue the word.

modes.label: Core
modes.description: The word core, often lowercase and joined to the following piece, as in core treatment period or Coregrafx.
modes.example: during the<< core>> treatment period. Of the 60

modes.label: Clinical Impact
modes.description: The word Impact in the heading Clinical Impact in drug interaction tables.
modes.example: Insulin or Insulin Secretagogues Clinical<< Impact>> The risk of hypoglycemia

modes.label: Split word starts
modes.description: The first piece of a word broken into parts, such as Achie or the brand name start VF.
modes.example: optimize fasting glucose.<< Achie>>ve optimal glucose control before starting each RE

card.writes: It suppresses common word endings like -ide, -ally and -ical, so it discourages a suffix from following.
card.plain: It fires on the word core and on Clinical Impact headings, and on the start of broken-up words.
